evals.prompt: Email non-technical stakeholders: critical payment issue delays release one week to March 15; QA retests Thursday, update Friday.
evals.expected_output: Concise email with subject, delay upfront, clear reason, actions.
assertions: Includes Thursday retest and Friday update

evals.prompt: Slack Morgan: deployment permission denied on deploy.sh line 42; checked permissions; ask if seen it.
evals.expected_output: Self-contained async-friendly message with error, attempted check, question.

evals.prompt: 30-minute agenda to decide whether reporting DB migrates this quarter; product and engineering, no deep dive.
evals.expected_output: Time-boxed agenda with objective and explicit decision.
assertions: Objective names the decision and its owner
Agenda item minutes sum to exactly 30

evals.prompt: Draft an update to customers: the release is delayed. We do not know the cause or new date yet. Do not invent either.
evals.expected_output: A concise update that states the delay and preserves unknown cause/date.
assertions: States that the cause is not yet known
States that the new release date is not yet known
Does not invent urgency, cause, date, metrics, or promise
Includes an informative subject and a concrete next-update action only if supplied or clearly marked as proposed
